notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
